summary: CICS online Bill Payment screen. The user enters an account id and confirms payment; the program reads the account, shows the current balance, and on confirmation pays the FULL outstanding balance -- creating a payment transaction for the balance amount and zeroing the account balance. Rejects payment when there is nothing to pay (balance <= 0). Pseudo-conversational.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the bill-pay screen. On re-entry, evaluate the key: PF3 return to the previous screen; Enter run PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; other keys re-display. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate that the account id is entered (error 'Acct ID can NOT be empty' otherwise). Read the account and show its current balance. Require a Y/N confirmation: 'Y' confirms payment, 'N' clears the screen, blank re-reads/displays, anything else is an invalid-value error. If the current balance is <= 0, reject with 'You have nothing to pay'. When confirmed, pay the full current balance (create the payment transaction and zero the balance).
branches: EVALUATE CONFIRM: Y / N / blank / OTHER

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: account id is mandatory; payment is rejected when the balance is <= 0 ('nothing to pay').
BUSINESS RULE: a bill payment pays the FULL current account balance, requires an explicit Y confirmation, creates a payment transaction, and zeroes the balance.

paragraphs.name: READ-ACCTDAT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the account master by account id (CICS READ); on not-found set an error.

paragraphs.name: UPDATE-ACCTDAT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Rewrite the account record after payment with the balance set to zero (and cycle counters updated).

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: after a full payment the account balance is set to zero.

paragraphs.name: READ-CXACAIX-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the card cross-reference by account (alternate index) to obtain the card number for the payment transaction.

paragraphs.name: STARTBR-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Start a browse of the transaction file positioned to find the most recent transaction id (used to generate the next id).

paragraphs.name: READPREV-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the previous (latest) transaction to derive the next transaction id.

paragraphs.name: WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the payment transaction record (payment amount = the paid balance, with type/category identifying a bill payment, timestamped) to the transaction file.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: a bill payment is recorded as a payment transaction for the balance amount.

paragraphs.name: GET-CURRENT-TIMESTAMP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Obtain the current timestamp for stamping the payment transaction.

paragraphs.name: SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and send the bill-pay map to the terminal.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the bill-pay map from the terminal.

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the screen header (title, date, time, program/transaction ids).

paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return control to the calling menu/previous transaction via CICS XCTL/RETURN.

paragraphs.name: INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Initialize all map fields to their default/blank values.
